title: Counting Bits
description: Given an integer `n`, return an array `ans` of length `n + 1` such that for each `i` (0 <= i <= n), `ans[i]` is the number of 1's in the binary representation of `i`.
output_format: Space-separated bit counts from 0 to n.
hints: Right-shifting drops the lowest bit whose count was already computed.
Computes answers for all numbers up to n in O(n) time.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    ans = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        ans[i] = ans[i >> 1] + (i & 1)
    print(' '.join(map(str, ans)))
